name: For-Duplicate key
source:
A story about a priest kidnapped by a witch making a master key. It's short, so it's also recommended for those who are not good at escape games.

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/5829]NovelGame[/url]]
translation:
一个关于被女巫绑架的牧师制作万能钥匙的故事。由于篇幅较短，所以也推荐给那些不擅长逃脱游戏的人。

[译自[url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/5829]NovelGame[/url]]
